headline: Microagi: Accelerating Embodied AGI for reliable real-world deployments
summary: Microagi, a data research lab, is focusing on developing end-to-end physical Artificial General Intelligence.
details: Microagi is a dedicated data research laboratory committed to advancing the field of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). Their primary objective is to accelerate the development of 'embodied AGI'.
The lab's work emphasizes creating AGI systems that can operate effectively in physical environments. A key focus is ensuring these real-world deployments are reliable and robust.
caption:
A new data research lab, Microagi, is pushing the boundaries of physical AGI.

Microagi is a dedicated data research laboratory committed to advancing the field of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). Their primary objective is to accelerate the development of 'embodied AGI'.

The lab's work emphasizes creating AGI systems that can operate effectively in physical environments. A key focus is ensuring these real-world deployments are reliable and robust.
